seo.title: About CCD
seo.description: CCD's story, mission, co-op model, team, and partners.

hero.title: We are Baltimore's cooperative future.
hero.body: Cooperative Community Development started with one reclaimed lot and grew into a member-governed blueprint for food, housing, green space, and ownership.
hero.alt: Welcome to Historic Irvington 1874 mosaic sign — where houses become homes and neighbors become friends

sections.title: A co-op grown from the block up.
sections.body: CCD was founded by Johnny Martin Jr. after years of watching investment promises miss Irvington. The answer was not another outside rescue plan. It was ownership from within: neighbors pooling dues, decisions, work, and vision.
bullets: Started from the Oasis @ 240 and reclaimed vacant land.
Acquired 3932-3934 Frederick Avenue for the Center for Social Impact.
Built programs that turn dues into visible community benefit.
sections.alt: Volunteers beside a newly built raised garden bed between rowhouses

sections.title: From one lot to a cooperative corridor.

items.title: The first lot
items.body: Neighbors began reclaiming neglected land and proving the model in public at Oasis @ 240.

items.title: CCD founded
items.body: Cooperative Community Development formalized the work with member governance in January 2020.

items.title: 3932-3934 acquired
items.body: The former Jarbo Brothers facility at 3932-3934 Frederick Avenue became the future Center for Social Impact, with support from BRED.

items.title: Cooperative Way
items.body: The block celebrated a new name and a visible cooperative identity.

items.title: The center opens
items.body: A co-op grocery, media center, maker stalls, and training space come online.

sections.title: What is a co-op?
sections.body: A cooperative is owned and governed by the people who use it. CCD keeps the benefits local and keeps decision-making in the hands of members.

cards.title: Members join
cards.body: Residents, businesses, nonprofits, and supporters pay dues that fund the shared work.

cards.title: Members govern
cards.body: One member gets one vote. Big decisions come back to the people closest to the work.

cards.title: Members share benefits
cards.body: Tool access, service discounts, markets, events, and neighborhood improvements stay local.
